legend: SNP array profile shows evidence of a doubled near-haploid/low-hypodiploid clone. Copy-neutral loss of heterozygosity is apparent for chromosomes 2–5, 7, 9, 13–17, 20, and X, indicating that the disomic state for these chromosomes was achieved through endoreduplication.
source: Dr. Lina Shao, Department of Pathology, University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, USA
